observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoor or evening powwow arena with a wooden dance floor and a seated audience in the background under dim lighting, featuring a spotlight on the performer.
observation.dancers: Solo female dancer per performance segment (part of a competition / spotlight special).
observation.formation_and_space: Solo dancer moving dynamically across the spotlighted dance floor, making turns and traveling patterns.
observation.posture: Upright torso with slight forward inclination during high-energy jumping and turning sequences, knees bending dynamically with weight transfer.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic high-stepping, hopping, and leaping on each beat of the music; exact foot-to-ground articulation obscured by low frame-rate and costume movement.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held out to the sides or extended to flare a large fringed shawl, creating sweeping wing-like motions.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains upright and aligned while turning and jumping; rotation driven by core and leg drive.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent jumps, single-foot hops, and fast spinning turns while maintaining balance.
observation.costume_and_props: Elaborate regalia including a large fringed shawl with rainbow or multi-colored fringe, dress with geometric beadwork/applique, matching leggings/moccasins, and a headpiece featuring feathers; competitor number pin visible.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and rapid micro-steps are occluded by the heavy fringe and low-resolution video sampling rate.

signature_moments.what: Fast spinning turn with arms extended wide, making the long shawl fringe fly outward
Rhythmic high-leg hops in place while holding arms outstretched to display the shawl
Rapid spinning pivot on one foot with the shawl flaring horizontally
